question: Should OpenClaw accept this curated OpenRouter model/capability table in this PR, fold it onto the newer shared `/images` endpoint PR, or pause it behind the broader OpenRouter image catalog policy?
rationale: The PR changes provider endpoint routing and image-generation capability contracts, while a newer open PR now owns a cleaner shared `/images` route; choosing the permanent provider policy and landing order requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Fold Onto Shared Endpoint Direction
options.body: Rebase this model/capability work onto or after the shared `/images` implementation so OpenRouter has one route implementation plus curated current IDs.

options.title: Accept This Branch After Rebase
options.body: Keep this provider-local implementation, resolve conflicts, and explicitly accept the curated model table as the current policy.

options.title: Pause For Catalog Policy
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged if maintainers prefer dynamic discovery or a separate catalog design before adding more curated OpenRouter image IDs.

recommendation.title: Fold Onto Shared Endpoint Direction
recommendation.body: Rebase this model/capability work onto or after the shared `/images` implementation so OpenRouter has one route implementation plus curated current IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses shared image helper, Plugin SDK, and provider-routing policy where the history points to steipete as the strongest adjacent owner.
